detail.title: WAKE Architectural Analysis and Governance Verification
detail.summary: This proposal focuses on resolving the measurement invalidity in the WAKE architecture experiment. By refining the verification logic in hypothesis h-wake-architecture-01 and re-running the architectural experiment, the system aims to clarify the stability of governance modules and transition verification. The project p-wake-self-study-01 remains the active focus.
